notes.viofo-a229-plus: Maximum-quality figures for front-only recording are not shown because the published chart contains inconsistent values.
notes.vueroid-s1-4k-infinite: Based on the space used by original recording files, including reserved space inside each file. The quality menu setting was not recorded.
notes.thinkware-q800-pro: The estimate covers the Front camera only. We still need a matching Rear recording sample.
notes.thinkware-f800-pro: The estimate covers the Front camera only. We still need a matching Rear recording sample.
notes.vantrue-n4: Includes original driving event recordings. Event clips are saved while driving, not in parking mode.
notes.70mai-4k-omni-x800: The 30 and 60 fps samples were recorded separately. Their quality settings may differ too. The two-camera estimate adds the Front and Rear sample rates.
notes.vantrue-n5: Both resolution options come from complete four-camera driving recordings. The exact quality menu setting wasn’t saved.
notes.cobra-sc-200d: Front-camera estimate. We still need a matching Rear recording sample.
notes.nextbase-622gw: Based on a matching Front and Rear driving clip saved with Alexa. File sizes vary across the sampled clips.
notes.papago-gosafe-760: Front-only estimates. The two resolutions were recorded in different sessions.
notes.viofo-a119s: These two 1080p60 samples use different recording rates. The range covers both, without assuming the same quality-menu selection.
notes.vueroid-s1-qhd-infinite: 30 fps data came from a three-camera setup. The 60 fps submission recorded only Front. Reduced-channel 30 fps results assume the same per-camera rate.
notes.70mai-t800: The published three-camera estimate does not specify whether the Rear camera is the 1080p or 4K version. Front-only FAQ figures conflict, so they are not included.
notes.cansonic-ultradash-z4-standard: High and Highest Quality come from separate submitted card sessions. Highest Quality varied across the sampled clips, so its recording times are shown as a range.
notes.ottocast-ottosafe-cam: Measured configuration only. Recording time varies with scene content and interrupted clips.
notes.thinkware-fa200: Measured configuration only. Recording time varies with scene content and interrupted clips.
notes.botslab-g980h: Measured configuration only. Recording time varies with scene content and interrupted clips.
notes.thinkware-arc-800: Measured configuration only. Recording time varies with scene content and interrupted clips.
